lines: Written against: @nextcloud/vue 8.31.0, 33 delivered packages; vue 2.7.16, 6 delivered packages.
Other delivered libraries: 4, vite-plugin-node-polyfills 0.24.0, toastify-js 1.12.0, vue-material-design-icons 5.3.1, path-browserify 1.0.1.

98 delivered files carry no source map, 3 files do. The bytes of the unmapped ones are charged only where the code shows its origin by itself: a copy of a file of the checkout, the glue of the bundler, code of the bundler and its plugins.
2 packages are imported by their root in src, each delivered in fewer than 8 modules, so a per-module import has nothing to leave out and the specifier decides no bytes here.
